english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for work or jobs involving office clerical duties.
Use this for the civilian or administrative side of public service, especially in contrast with the military.

examples.english: This clerical job mainly involves helping to handle documents.
examples.traditional: 呢份文職工作主要係幫手處理文件。

examples.english: There are quite a few civil administrative staff in the government, so they do not have to fight on the front line.
examples.traditional: 政府入面有唔少文職人員，唔使去前線打仗。
